nesting: Developer native API supports child spawning and nested child spawning. Manager may delegate within four shared active slots.
settings: Developer guarantee: full-history forks inherit exact parent model and reasoning effort and do not accept overrides. No agents.default_subagent_model/default_subagent_reasoning_effort or custom agent entries in user config; project .codex/config.toml absent. Use fork_turns all, omit overrides.
independence: Manager is coordinator. All initial solvers must be dispatched before sibling candidate contents enter coordinator history; returns paths/hashes/status until dispatch complete.
memory: No writes to Codex memories or project MEMORY during this execution: higher-priority developer requires an explicit user memory request. Read-only context remains permitted.
